note: Majority: null. The Civil Code of Guinea was not read; the Secretariat-General of the Government (sgg.gov.gn) answered 403. Work: Code du travail de la République de Guinée, Loi n° L/2014/072/CNT du 10 janvier 2014 (FAOLEX's copy of the official text): art. 121.4 a contract of employment may be made only with one who has reached the minimum age of sixteen; art. 137.5 children may not be employed in any undertaking before sixteen at least, save as apprentices under arts. 142.1 ff. (from fourteen, which the form doesn't hold), and a ministerial order lists work barred under eighteen. Performers: the Code makes no exception for performing (its only mentions of shows are the worst forms of child labour and entertainment businesses' Sunday rest), so the form holds barred (my reading).
